notes.title: GSC Game World Birthday Sale
notes.notes:
Here we are again, on these lands. The cannons are loaded, the sabers are waiting for their time…. Boots and guns are polished to a shine. We know what's coming. I can feel this smell in the air. It is a mixture of sweat, terror, gunpowder, and bread. Who are we without bread? I definitely remember that it was warmer last time. It wasn't snowing, the meadows were just beginning to bloom, but our boots mercilessly chewed the green sprouts under them. Damned be that war, it's true.

What awaits us? Another fight? Yes, undoubtedly. It will be a good battle – we have been waiting for it. My good saber is ready for all the obstacles. Whether it's a rapier, a halberd or a mace! I will meet them all with peace on my face. Because I know what I'm fighting for. And I know that this fight will not be the last.

Starting from December 5, until December 12, during the GSC Game World birthday sale, you will have the opportunity to join the fight in «Cossacks» or somewhere else in another game of ours. And as long as your hand can select units on the battlefield, the «Cossack» series will always welcome new reinforcements.

Have a successful winter offensive, Cossacks.

notes.title: Now Available - Cossacks: Back to War
notes.notes:
Cossacks: Back to War is now available on Steam and 20% off until 9/8/2010.

To stand alone in war is extremely unpleasant. Extremely pleasant, on the other hand, is the stand-alone version Cossacks: Back to War. Containing all of the gameplay features of Cossacks: European Wars and Cossacks: The Art of War, this is a complete care package for all current and future Cossacks fans. This add-on contains 100 captivating missions taking place between the 16th and 18th centuries. In addition, two new nations, Switzerland and Hungary, are included. These countries waged war in the late Middle Ages and essentially influenced the development of European military strategies. This addition causes the second add-on of Cossacks to pass the threshold of allowed gaming fun.
